proposed.text: Under the 2024 BP 344 IRR, what is the minimum height for edge protection curbs on accessible ramps, and what is the rationale for this requirement?
proposed.code_citation: BP 344 2024 Revised IRR, Appendix A, Accessible Ramps, Item 14, PDF p.2.
proposed.rationale: The 2024 BP 344 IRR Appendix A accessible-ramp excerpt requires a raised edge on both sides of the ramp with a minimum height of 100 mm. The edge protection helps keep wheels, canes, and other mobility aids from slipping off the ramp edge. The distractors either understate the source value, confuse edge protection with handrail height, or treat edge protection as optional.
